title: The Secret Hunter
description: This project adds the Secret Hunter gamemode to Minecraft
body:
This simple plugin adds the "Secret Hunter gamemode to Minecraft. By default, 25 NPC's will spawn per player. When a round starts, each player is given a wooden sword, and the goal to kill a specific player. Your goal is to act like an NPC and try not to get caught, while also trying to kill your target. You can choose to kill more than just the player that was assigned as your target, but be careful because if you kill 3 NPC's, you automatically die and are put into spectator mode and are out of the round.

-----Commands-----

/game start (starts the game)
/game stop (stops the game)
/game length *set minutes* (allows you to change the duration of the game in minutes, by default 10)

-----Set up-----

**This plugin requires Citizens to function correctly.**
By default, all NPC's are set to armour stands (to prevent crashing if Citizens is not yet installed). To fix this, go into your plugins folder, SecretHunter, config.yml, and change npcsMode: ARMOR_STANDS" to "npcsMode: CITIZENS_PLAYER" after installing Citizens into your plugins folder.

To control starting and stopping of a round, you must have admin permissions.

-----Possible Future Updates-----

Tasks to be completed within the 10 minute time frame
Choosing maps
More commands (e.g. /game maxPlayers *number*)
